description:
This week, Supervising Location Manager Kevin Funston joins us to discuss the incredible Los Angeles locations featured throughout Marvel Television’s Wonder Man. We also celebrate the return of Knull in an all-new comic book series with a deep dive into the god of the symbiotes. Co-writers Al Ewing and Tom Waltz also stop by to share what readers can expect from this exciting new chapter in Knull’s story.
